description: Groundwork hooks, hand written. Publish generates only the skills folder, never this file. Registers the siteoffice-git guard once: it denies raw git commands in an agent session. Runs powershell, else pwsh, and does nothing when neither is installed.

hooks.command: if command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/siteoffice-git/hooks/git_guard.ps1"; elif command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/siteoffice-git/hooks/git_guard.ps1"; fi; exit 0
